---
title: Accessibility-First
description: A theme that applies Universal Design for Learning principles as the primary instructional design constraint.
---

**Theme ID:** `accessibility-first`

## Token Defaults

```yaml
scaffolding.level: medium
agency.mode: bounded-choice
feedback.mode: mixed
assessment.evidence: artifact-plus-reflection
revision.required: true
reflection.required: true
accessibility.mode: universal-design
accessibility.mediaAlternatives: [captions, transcript, alt-text, printable]
bandwidth.assumption: medium
```

## Best For
Any course where learner diversity is a primary design consideration. Recommended as a baseline for all globally-distributed OER.
